profile.org_note: Small, centrally run private builder: one Opelika head office, no published division presidents. CEO Frank Plan (a shareholder who joined as head of land acquisition and development) and COO John Manasco are the only two executives with company-wide authority named in public; land is held and bank-financed through an affiliate, SMB Land, LLC, under the holding company Sky Holdings, Inc., with Plan as registered agent of all three entities. No CFO, controller, treasurer or land executive is named anywhere public. The five areas listed under regions are the company's own service-area grouping, not confirmed management divisions.
profile.summary: Private Alabama production builder founded in 2006, headquartered in Opelika, building detached single-family homes (plus the entry-level THRIVE line) in about 20 cities across Auburn-Opelika, Montgomery, Huntsville, Dothan-Enterprise, Troy and the Columbus, Georgia area. Construction Dive reported 806 closings and $333M revenue for 2024 (No. 76 on the 2025 Builder 100); the 2026 list puts it lower on fewer closings. It is a conventional for-sale builder that develops its own communities and buys raw land directly (it runs a public land-submissions page), financed by regional banks through a land affiliate, with no land banker named publicly, so it is a plausible but small land-banking prospect.
